{{Quote|This is Toluz Cheq in the Rial Kroon system. My Padawan is dead, my fleet is destroyed, and I have no means of escape. This is my final report.|Toluz Cheq|<ref name="Hero 1" />}}
'''Toluz Cheq''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] who served the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], commanding a [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] of [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyers]]. Although considered to be one of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order's]] best [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]], Cheq still found himself outmatched in a [[Battle of the Rial Kroon system|space battle]] in the [[Rial Kroon system/Legends|Rial Kroon system]], where he was pursued and eventually brought down by [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|Vulture droids]] of a new design. Cheq's [[Toluz Cheq's Padawan|Padawan]] was also [[Death/Legends|killed]] during the battle. However, before his death, Cheq managed to transmit valuable data on the new Confederate [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] to the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Our ships are no match for their speed. We must&mdash;|Master Cheq's last words|<ref name="Hero 1" />}}
Toluz Cheq was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] who lived during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Cheq was an exceptional [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]], and at some point in his life, he went through flight training with [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Cheq had a [[Toluz Cheq's Padawan|Padawan]] and commanded a [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] of [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyers]].<ref name="Hero 1" /> In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="HotC date" /> Cheq's fleet was [[Battle of the Rial Kroon system|attacked]] in the [[Rial Kroon system/Legends|Rial Kroon system]] by [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|Vulture droid starfighters]] of an unusual design. Cheq himself engaged the enemy in a [[Delta-7B Aethersprite-class light interceptor/Legends|Delta-7B ''Aethersprite''-class light interceptor]], managing to gather some data on the Vultures during the fight. Cheq's forces, however, proved to be no match for the new Confederate [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]], which greatly excelled them in speed.<ref name="Hero 1" />

[[File:Rial_Kroon_system.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Cheq is killed by Confederate starfighters.]]
The entire Republic fleet was soon decimated, and Cheq's [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] was [[Death/Legends|killed]]. Realizing that he would not be able to escape, Cheq ordered his [[Toluz Cheq's R3-series astromech droid|R3 unit]] to establish a [[Hologram/Legends|holographic]] connection with the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. Cheq managed to inform the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] of his predicament and transmitted the data on the Vulture [[Droid/Legends|droids]] before his starfighter was destroyed by enemy fire, killing him. Analyzing Cheq's data, the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] found out that the new Vulture droids were outfitted with advanced [[Engine/Legends|engines]] manufactured by the people of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Valahari/Legends|Valahari]]. Hoping to persuade the planet's [[House of Vane|royal house]] to stop selling the engines to the Confederacy, Skywalker and Master [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] went to Valahari on a [[Diplomat/Legends|diplomatic]] mission.<ref name="Hero 1" />

==Personality and traits==
Toluz Cheq was a [[Color/Legends|green]]-skinned Rodian with blue [[Eye/Legends|eyes]]. Realizing the importance of notifying the Jedi Order of the new model of Vulture droids, Cheq spent the final moments of his life to transmit the data on the starfighters to his fellow Jedi.<ref name="Hero 1" />

==Powers and abilities==
{{Quote|Master Cheq was one of our best pilots, Chancellor. We went through flight training together.''"<br />"''My sympathies. This war has claimed a great many good Jedi.|Anakin Skywalker and [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]]|<ref name="Hero 1" />}}
Cheq was a very talented pilot, considered one of the best among the Jedi. However, his flying skills were not good enough to defeat the new Vulture droids or allow the Jedi Master to escape from them.<ref name="Hero 1" />

==Equipment==
While serving as a Jedi, Cheq wore brown-colored [[Clothing/Legends|clothing]].<ref name="Hero 1" />

==Behind the scenes==
Toluz Cheq appeared in [[The Clone Wars 10|''The Clone Wars'' 10]], a [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] written by [[Henry Gilroy]] and [[Steven Melching]], illustrated by [[Brian Koschak]], and released by [[Dark Horse Comics]]<ref name="Hero 1" /> on [[November 11]], [[2009]].<ref name="Dark Horse">{{DarkHorse|url=Comics/16-241/Star-Wars-The-Clone-Wars-10----Hero-of-the-Confederacy-part-1|text=Star Wars: The Clone Wars #10 &mdash; Hero of the Confederacy part 1}}</ref>
